title: Fix Introduction Step Border Emphasis Across Steps
description: The first introduction step correctly shows emphasized border with cursor inside and normal border with cursor outside, but subsequent steps wrongly always keep the emphasized border.
summary: Introduction info boxes no longer stay emphasized after advancing steps. Root cause: :focus-within stayed true because Next kept keyboard focus. Introduction boxes now emphasize on :hover only; dialogs still use :hover and :focus-within. Extended the glass-box vitest to assert this split.
